title: Execute selected proof and keep machine-local evidence local

intent.outcome: Execute the currently selected proof set through one typed, resumable operation that owns run identity, command capture, compact receipt reconciliation, and honest claim scope; give ignored machine-local config focused local proof without repository residue.
non_goals: Do not replace manual receipt admission as an interoperability and recovery route.
Do not promote machine-local evidence into repository, PR, release, or parent-lane authority.
Do not introduce a second proof framework or make every proof selection a broad suite.
